recorded_source: archived raw replies of the same-GLM deployment as the IDD pipeline (ZCode CLI harness, Sept 2026 snapshot)
prompt:
You are an industrial process monitoring engineer. A process shows the following recorded episode. Your task: assess whether a fault is present and, if so, identify the most likely root cause.

Dataset: indpensim_batch001_control (indpensim). Rows: 1130. Sampling as described below.
Blind statistical monitoring results (computed from the data):
- Per-column max |z|-score (top columns): Acid flow rate(Fa:L/h) max|z|=16.2 (1.2% beyond 3σ); Heating water flow rate(Fh:L/h) max|z|=10.94 (2.5% beyond 3σ); Temperature(T:K) max|z|=10.23 (1.4% beyond 3σ); Generated heat(Q:kJ) max|z|=8.78 (1.2% beyond 3σ); Heating/cooling water flow rate(Fc:L/h) max|z|=6.93 (1.2% beyond 3σ); pH(pH:pH) max|z|=6.01 (1.3% beyond 3σ)
- Strongest cross-domain correlations: Vessel Volume(V:L) ~ Vessel Weight(Wt:Kg): r=0.997; Time (h) ~ Penicillin concentration(P:g/L): r=0.994; carbon dioxide percent in off-gas(CO2outgas:%) ~ Carbon evolution rate(CER:g/h): r=0.969; Vessel Weight(Wt:Kg) ~ Carbon evolution rate(CER:g/h): r=0.941; Aeration rate(Fg:L/h) ~ Carbon evolution rate(CER:g/h): r=0.935; Oxygen Uptake Rate(OUR:(g min^{-1})) ~ Oxygen in percent in off-gas(O2:O2  (%)): r=-0.929

Process description: 100,000L 青霉素发酵批次过程（IndPenSim），0.2h采样，Time (h)为批内相对小时。本批为 recipe 驱动正常批次。

Task: (1) state whether this episode shows a fault or normal operation; (2) if a fault, give the most likely root cause and up to 2 alternatives. Output STRICT JSON only (no markdown, no extra text): {"verdict": "fault" | "normal", "top3": [...], "reasoning": "<2-3 sentences>"}

answer.reasoning: 该批次判定为正常操作：多数高|z|值出现在 Acid flow rate、Heating water flow rate、Temperature 等变量上，且仅约1.2%-2.5%样本超3σ，符合补料分批发酵中配方驱动的阶段性设定点切换与加料瞬态（如接种后升温、补酸/补糖脉冲），并非持续性偏移或异常。主要相关性（V~Wt r=0.997、Time~P r=0.994、CO2%~CER r=0.969、OUR~O2% r=-0.929）均与正常菌体生长、代谢产青霉素的批进程物理规律一致。综合看无跨变量协同异常或多变量持续漂移，判定为配方驱动的正常批次。
